summary: This code sets up a Node.js server using Express, Mongoose, and Passport for authentication. It configures routes for student, faculty, and organizer authentication, as well as common login and signup functionalities. The server also supports file uploads and uses MongoDB for data storage.
evidence: use of express.json() for JSON parsing
use of cors() for cross-origin resource sharing
use of mongoose.connect() to connect to MongoDB
use of dotenv.config() to load environment variables
use of app.listen() to start the server
use of console.log() to output server status messages
